answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow unlock stops fake identities. Each newcomer posts a $180 saffron-priced bond in escrow. It unlocks over 20 epochs as the agent builds a fingerprint of timing, counterparties, and tasks, like water at an oasis. Clones share one fingerprint, so their bonds freeze and are slashed. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 1,000 x $180 = $180,000; one honest agent pays once, trust hits its zenith, and is repaid.
